doc: Committed registry of experiments (AGENTS.md: Mishe carries nothing dead). Each experiment ends as adopted (wired to a consumer or check, with the evidence stated) or retired (deleted, with its tests, docs and boundaries; recoverable from git history). checks/experiments-lifecycle.py reads this file. status: running | adopted | retired. decision_due is an ISO date; a running experiment past it is AMBER, and RED a week later. paths lists the tracked files an experiment owns, so the scan can tell registered artifacts from unregistered ones.

experiments.decision: Retired 2026-11-21 with its files, extra, parsing-policy entry and README row. The pilot on src/mishe_tauftauf (2349 definitions, 0 incomplete paths) listed syntactic name candidates; one, is_recursive_c_l_diverse in body_perception.py, had no tracked reference other than its definition. No consumer or check read the list, and the experiment could not gate anything. Recover with: git show f5b1066c:tools/code_map_experiment.py
experiments.consumer_or_evidence: none: no consumer; pilot evidence recorded on the steward wall

experiments.decision: Adopted for the building block, retired for the loop. The internal loop was deleted in 943276d9 and stays deleted. docs_tools.search_docs stays because repo_change_docs.docs_naming calls it (the docs-naming seam of the repo-change initiative). The narrative in docs/agent-step-experiments.md is local and gitignored; its status line now says so.
experiments.consumer_or_evidence: src/mishe_tauftauf/repo_change_docs.py imports search_docs; tests/test_docs_tools.py covers it

duty rssi-motion (hourly) writes senses/map/rssi-motion.json (phone) and senses/map/rssi-motion-router-station.json (router-station, from the senses archive senses/map/router-station-redmi10.jsonl); go ahead = a variance feature beats the level and a day-shift null (verdict SIGNAL) and a consumer such as the map rssi line reads it; retire = still NO_SIGNAL at the decision date after the phone-still and per-hour strata have been tried
